name: Limova
short_description: French (Nice) no-code platform of specialized AI agents for SMBs — phone, marketing, SEO, sales, accounting, legal and recruitment — automating everyday business tasks.
notes: source: blogdumoderateur.com. 8 role-based agents; 7-day free trial; 'Tom' phone add-on €0.20/min; plan prices not shown on page (trial-gated). Pricing to confirm.

name: AirAgent
short_description: French voice AI (callbot/voicebot) that answers and places business calls 24/7 — appointment booking, call routing, lead qualification, reminders and ticketing — with 3,000+ integrations.
notes: source: Google / eliocall.com review. Starts ~€89/mo per third-party reviews, not shown on site. Theme could also be Sales (appointment-setting). Pricing to confirm.

name: Runner H
short_description: French computer-use agent that follows natural-language instructions to navigate web UIs, click, read documents and automate end-to-end workflows, self-repairing when a UI changes.
notes: source: Wikipedia / hcompany.ai. Currently private beta (waitlist); API access in beta; no public pricing.

name: Subti
short_description: French platform to build autonomous 'AI employees' — multimodal agents that automate business tasks end to end.
notes: source: Legend Media (YouTube) / theresanaiforthat.com. Also spelled substi.ai. Capabilities/pricing to confirm (site blocked automated fetch).
